principle: A downstream Logion node receives a signal only when a material qualitative delta crosses the configured threshold.

diagnostic.writes: optional ledger only when --write is supplied
diagnostic.use: inspect drift and explain why no further chain should run

test.use: prove delta routing and idempotence without operational effects

release.triggers_downstream: only when significant_delta=true and no-send locks remain valid
release.use: release verification; checks must not dirty artifacts without material delta

non_significant_examples: diagnostic command with unchanged semantic snapshot
cache refresh that does not change release-visible artifact hashes
